aboutness.basis: University of Dar es Salaam, Muhimbili University of Health and Allied Sciences and Sokoine University of Agriculture are directly studied.
aboutness.verified_excerpt: Respondents highlight internal research funds, local partners, international grants and supportive governance as financing mechanisms.

topic.label: Research funding
topic.basis: Sustainable research funding is the core empirical subject.

futures.mechanism: Grant-management capacity, early-career support and university research financing models.
futures.why_could_matter: If controlled evaluation supports proposals, mixed funding and mentoring models could improve continuity of Tanzanian university research.
futures.uncertainty: Purposive 37-person sample, respondent perspectives and three-institution coverage do not establish general or causal impacts.
futures.research_question: Which funding and mentorship interventions improve grant continuity and junior researcher outcomes in Tanzanian universities?

source_verification.basis: SAGE Science, Technology and Society article metadata/abstract lists exact DOI and first online publication 31 Aug 2025, focusing on bilateral science agreements and aerospace cases.

aboutness.basis: Argentina–China cooperation, including the Bajada del Agrio deep-space antenna, is a substantive national case alongside Brazil.
aboutness.verified_excerpt: The article analyzes Chinese science diplomacy through agreements and the Argentine deep-space antenna case.

topic.label: Science diplomacy
topic.basis: Science diplomacy and cross-border research infrastructure are direct subjects.

futures.mechanism: Aerospace science facilities, space partnerships, technical training and international scientific agreements.
futures.why_could_matter: If participation and data-access terms are documented, the Argentina infrastructure case could inform research on local benefits of international science cooperation.
futures.uncertainty: SAGE full text is restricted; agreement terms, operational access and independent assessment of benefits still require verification.
futures.research_question: What evidence shows whether Argentina-based aerospace collaborations create sustained local scientific access and expertise?
